theorems.name: Submission.ecf_cp_gc_det_orth
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (b : Euclid P) (w : Fin k → Euclid P), (∀ j : Fin k, inner ℝ b (w j) = 0) → Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (k + 1) => inner ℝ ((Fin.cons b w : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) i) ((Fin.cons b w : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) j)) = ‖b‖ ^ 2 * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin k => inner ℝ (w i) (w j))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
